title: Harness output (review / refactor variant)
description: The object a base skill emits inside a ```json:harness-output fenced block when running under HARNESS_MODE_INLINE for the review or refactor deep target. Parsed by scripts/harness_common/parser.py.

iteration.description: The iteration this output belongs to, copied from iteration.current in the progress file.

new_findings.description: Findings discovered this iteration, including ones no fix was applied for.

fixes_applied.description: The subset of new_findings actually edited into the tree via Edit/MultiEdit. One entry per edit location: a fix spanning several places in one file contributes several entries.

no_new_findings.description: True when this iteration discovered zero new findings. Drives the orchestrator's convergence termination.

no_actionable_fixes.description: True ONLY when every finding has an empty pre_edit_content, i.e. no swap pair was captured for any of them. A finding with a non-empty pre_edit_content and a different post_edit_content is actionable regardless of file type — markdown, JSON, config, and code all qualify.

file.description: Path relative to the project root, forward slashes.

end_line.description: 1-indexed end line; equal to line for a single-line finding.

category.description: Skill-specific category taken from the agent finding (Bug, Guideline Violation, Testability Barrier, ...).

guideline.description: The specific project rule, or a 'General: ...' fallback.

fix_description.description: Brief description of the fix applied. Empty when no fix was applied.

confidence.description: Post-validation confidence. Low findings are recorded for the report and the next iteration's context but never earn a fix — see the auto-apply gate in references/harness-mode.md step 4.

agent.description: Name of the analysis agent that produced the finding.

pre_edit_content.description: The exact original text that was replaced. Empty means no fix was applied. Bisection reverts by string swap, so this must match the tree byte for byte.

post_edit_content.description: The exact replacement text. An empty string is valid and means the fix deletes the matched code.
